basics.description:
**Bluechip Data Platform (BDP)** — a management plane that installs and runs data tools on your AKS cluster.

Before you begin, ensure: an ingress controller is installed with the Azure LB health-probe annotation `service.beta.kubernetes.io/azure-load-balancer-health-probe-request-path: /healthz`; wildcard DNS `*.<your domain>` points at the ingress load-balancer IP; and the cluster can pull from the image registry (AKS `--attach-acr` or a pull secret). Minimum size: 3 × Standard_D4s_v5.

basics.name: externalDomain
basics.label: External domain
basics.toolTip: The DNS name the BDP UI is served on, e.g. bdp.contoso.com. Tool UIs use per-tool subdomains (spark.<domain>), so a wildcard *.<domain> record must resolve to the ingress load-balancer.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid fully-qualified domain name (e.g. bdp.contoso.com).

basics.name: ingressClassName
basics.label: Ingress class name
basics.toolTip: The IngressClass of your installed ingress controller (usually 'nginx').

constraints.validationMessage: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.

basics.name: adminEmail
basics.label: Administrator email
basics.toolTip: Contact email for the platform administrator (optional).

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid email address or leave blank.

subLabel.preValidation: Configure where the cluster pulls BDP + tool images from.

options.text: BDP is air-gap ready: all images are pulled from one registry. If your AKS is attached to that ACR (`az aks update --attach-acr`) you can leave the credentials blank; otherwise provide pull credentials.

elements.name: airgapRegistry
elements.label: Air-gap image registry
elements.toolTip: The registry (usually your ACR) that holds the BDP platform images and mirrored tool images.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a valid registry host (e.g. myacr.azurecr.io).

elements.name: airgapRegistryUsername
elements.label: Registry username (optional)
elements.toolTip: Leave blank if the cluster is --attach-acr or the registry allows anonymous pull.

elements.name: airgapRegistryPassword
elements.toolTip: Leave blank if the cluster is --attach-acr or the registry allows anonymous pull.

options.text: For production, provide a TLS secret (a wildcard cert for *.<domain>, e.g. issued by cert-manager). Only enable 'Skip TLS verification' for non-production testing.

elements.name: tlsSecretName
elements.label: TLS secret name (production)
elements.toolTip: Name of a Kubernetes TLS secret holding a wildcard certificate for *.<domain>. Leave blank only for testing.

elements.name: insecureSkipTlsVerify
elements.label: Skip TLS verification (testing only)
elements.toolTip: Accepts self-signed certificates. Do NOT enable in production.

options.text: Storage class applies to NEW installs only — changing it later does not move or resize existing volumes. Sizes set the initial PersistentVolumeClaim capacity; most CSI drivers support online expansion afterwards, but shrinking a volume is not supported.

elements.name: storageClass
elements.label: Storage class
elements.toolTip: The Kubernetes StorageClass used for platform PersistentVolumeClaims (PostgreSQL, Redis, shared data). New-install only. 'Cluster default' uses whatever StorageClass your AKS cluster marks as default.

elements.name: postgresSizeGi
elements.label: PostgreSQL volume size (GiB)
elements.toolTip: Size of the PostgreSQL primary PersistentVolumeClaim, in GiB.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a whole number of GiB between 1 and 9999.

elements.name: redisSizeGi
elements.label: Redis volume size (GiB)
elements.toolTip: Size of the Redis master PersistentVolumeClaim, in GiB.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a whole number of GiB between 1 and 9999.

elements.name: sharedDataSizeGi
elements.label: Shared data volume size (GiB)
elements.toolTip: Size of the shared RWX PersistentVolumeClaim (bdp-shared-data) used for cross-tool drop folders, in GiB.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter a whole number of GiB between 1 and 99999.
